verdict.rationale: Weave records token usage and calculates cost automatically for each call from supported integrations (OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere, Mistral), applying built-in per-model pricing, and custom costs can be added via `add_cost`. Costs appear in the trace tree and calls table in the UI, so per-request visibility is clearly documented, but the evidence shows no dashboards aggregating cost by model or over time. Missing for 10: aggregated cost/token dashboards by model, time-period trend views, independent or hands-on corroboration.
